description: Retrieves a list of Stripe products, with optional filtering and pagination; `starting_after`/`ending_before` cursors must be valid product IDs from a previous response.

active.description: Filter products based on their active status. Set to `True` to return only active products, or `False` for inactive ones.
active.title: Active

created.description: Filters products by their creation date range. Provide a dictionary with keys like 'gt' (greater than), 'gte' (greater than or equal to), 'lt' (less than), or 'lte' (less than or equal to) and Unix timestamp values (seconds since epoch). For instance, `{'gte': 1609459200, 'lte': 1640995200}` filters for products created from January 1, 2021, to January 1, 2022.
created.title: Created

ending_before.description: A cursor for use in pagination to fetch the previous page of results. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if a list request returns objects ending with `prod_XYZ`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before='prod_XYZ'` to fetch the previous page.
ending_before.title: Ending Before

ids.description: A list of product IDs to retrieve. If provided, only products with these specific IDs will be returned.
ids.title: Ids

limit.description: A limit on the number of product objects to be returned. The value must be an integer between 1 and 100, inclusive. If not specified, the default is 10.
limit.title: Limit

shippable.description: Filter products based on whether they are shippable. Set to `True` to return only shippable products, or `False` for non-shippable ones.
shippable.title: Shippable

starting_after.description: A cursor for use in pagination to fetch the next page of results. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if a list request returns objects and the last object's ID is `prod_ABC`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after='prod_ABC'` to fetch the next page.
starting_after.title: Starting After

url.description: Filter products by a specific URL. Only products with this exact URL will be returned.
url.title: Url

name: list_products

ListProductsResponse.description: Response from listing Stripe products with pagination.

data.description: An array containing the actual product objects, paginated by any request parameters.
data.title: Data

has_more.description: Whether or not there are more elements available after this set. If false, this set comprises the end of the list.
has_more.title: Has More

object.description: String representing the object's type. Value is 'list'.
object.title: Object

url.description: The URL for accessing this list.
url.title: Url

ListProductsResponse.title: ListProductsResponse
